canonical_definition: MM-Vet is a multimodal vision-language benchmark designed to evaluate integrated capabilities across diverse categories such as reasoning, perception, and knowledge retention, with task formats emphasizing cross-modal integration and generalization in real-world scenarios. It assesses models through 6 core vision-language capabilities and 16 integrative tasks, often framed as a measure of robustness and multifaceted information processing. Some papers highlight its focus on retained general capabilities and parallel recognition-sequential understanding workflows, while others emphasize its role in evaluating multimodal LLMs under challenging, open-ended conditions.
